svg.title: Unlimited slot shapes
svg.desc: A data 1 (Tukey beep), a data 0 (silence), a START/STOP marker with its mid-slot twist, the start of the tune tone, and the twist zoomed, rendered by the Encoder (hf preset, 48 kHz).
svg.text: Slot shapes: real Encoder audio, hf preset (T 16 ms, 1500 Hz)
Rendered by the Encoder at 48000 Hz; amplitude relative to the crest A; dashed: the envelopes of spec 1.1.
no tone for the whole slot
the beep + a twist at T/2
The twist, zoomed: the flat top of the marker above, u = 0.25…0.75 of the slot
purple: Encoder audio; gray dotted: the carrier before the twist, continued; shaded: 0.375 T – 0.625 T
the twist: amplitude through 0, phase turns 180°
A marker is a data beep whose second half is upside down: the ear hears the same beep, the receiver sees the twist.
After a marker the carrier stays inverted (s ← −s) until the next marker; data slots never reverse the phase.
Energy per slot (T·A²/2): data 1 0.6875, marker 0.5625. Every envelope is 0 at the slot edges: no key clicks.
